[[File:Death_Canyon.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Death Canyon.]]
'''Death Canyon''' was an elaborate maze of boulders and other natural landforms. It had only one way out, through [[Thunder Road (location)|Thunder Road]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] escaped from [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] in Death Canyon during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
